segments: The tenth cycle:
The Arab kings.
And he looked up to heaven and said:
"O Lord and Maker of all,
You know my intention, that it was set upon good,
while this one, my enemy,
he began and chose evil.
I beseech You now,
repay him according to his deeds!"
And from here he began sending troops into the land of the Persians
and devastating places with the edge of the sword,
as we are going to show.
Concerning the expedition. And in the year six hundred of the Arabs,
which is the year 1515
of the Greeks
(1204 of our Lord?) in the month of Nisan,
the Franks took Constantinople from the Greeks,
and they brought their kingdom to an end in it.
For the king of the Greeks had taken the sister of the king of France as his wife,
and she bore him a son.
And the king of the Greeks had a brother;
this man rebelled against the king,
and blinded his eyes,
and killed him in prison.
Then the son of the slain man fled to his maternal uncle, the king of France,
and he became zealous, gathered forces, and came and encamped against Constantinople.
And because the citizens were not pleased with the tyrant's deed against his brother,
they set fire to the city,
and the warriors on the walls were thrown into confusion,
and the Franks scaled [the walls] and entered the city,
and the tyrant fled.
And the Franks seated that young boy upon the throne of the kingdom,
in appearance only and in name,
while all authority was theirs.
And they began oppressing the citizens with heavy taxes,
and they plundered the treasures of the churches, the crosses, the Gospel covers,
and the gold and silver that were upon the icons.
Now the citizens, when they saw that they were being mercilessly plundered by the Franks,
rushed upon the boy, the son of the Greek king, and killed him,
and they also drove the Franks out of the city,
and shut the gates against them.
And the Franks remained outside fighting,
and the battle was prolonged, and those inside became weak.
And they sent and took refuge with Sultan Rukn al-Din, the lord of Iconium,
but he was unable to help them.
